   [1;3;4mPlan: add greet.sh[0m

   [1mContext[0m

   Add a small shell script, [38;2;177;185;249mgreet.sh[39m, to the probe worktree root that prints "hello".

   [1mSteps[0m

   1. Confirm the working directory is the probe worktree.
   2. Check that [38;2;177;185;249mgreet.sh[39m does not already exist.
   3. Decide the script lives at the worktree root.
   4. Choose [38;2;177;185;249m/bin/sh[39m as the interpreter.
   5. Open a new file named [38;2;177;185;249mgreet.sh[39m.
   6. Write the shebang line [38;2;177;185;249m#!/bin/sh[39m.
   7. Add a blank line after the shebang.
   8. Add the line [38;2;177;185;249mecho hello[39m.
   9. End the file with a trailing newline.
   10. Save the file.
   11. Confirm the file exists with [38;2;177;185;249mls[39m.
   12. Confirm the contents are exactly two lines plus a blank.
   13. Check the shebang has no stray whitespace.                                                                     [38;2;153;153;153m↓[39m
